blocks.source: 【音楽室】Mystic Star：フィールド曲
blocks.translation: [Music Room] Mystic Star: Field Theme

blocks.source: NR_field1.mp3（☆☆☆☆）
blocks.translation: NR_field1.mp3 (☆☆☆☆)

blocks.source: 最初に作った無難なフィールド曲。
blocks.translation: The first safe, unassuming field theme I made.

blocks.source: 自分の作曲家人生の中でも、超初期に作りました。
blocks.translation: I made it very early in my career as a composer.

blocks.source: もっといい曲ができたら後で差し替えようと思っていたのですが、結局本採用となりました。
blocks.translation: I thought I would replace it later if I made a better song, but it ended up being officially adopted.

blocks.source: なんというか、序盤フィールドらしい妙な安定感があって、これ以外はしっくり来なかったんですよね。
blocks.translation: It had a certain strange stability that felt just right for an early-game field, and nothing else really felt right.

blocks.source: NR_field2.mp3（☆☆☆☆☆）
blocks.translation: NR_field2.mp3 (☆☆☆☆☆)

blocks.source: 後半フィールド兼メインテーマ。
blocks.translation: The late-game field theme and main theme.

blocks.source: これも自分の作曲家人生で、初期に作った曲。
blocks.translation: This was also one of the songs I made early in my career as a composer.

blocks.source: 同時に自分が初めて「これいけるんじゃね？」と手応えを感じた曲でもあります。
blocks.translation: At the same time, it was the first song that made me feel, “Hey, maybe this could work.”

blocks.source: 派手目なイントロから笛へ。いかにも後半フィールドらしい仕上がりとなっております。
blocks.translation: It moves from a flashy intro into a flute melody. It turned out exactly like a late-game field theme should.

blocks.source: 音色的にＦＦ６を思い浮かべるかもしれませんが、どちらかというとバハムートラグーンの前半とかブレスオブファイア２の後半とか、その辺からのインスパイヤです。
blocks.translation: The instrumentation may remind you of FF6, but it was actually inspired more by the first half of Bahamut Lagoon and the second half of Breath of Fire II, among others.

blocks.source: NR_field12.mp3（☆☆☆）
blocks.translation: NR_field12.mp3 (☆☆☆)

blocks.source: 地底旅行。
blocks.translation: A journey beneath the earth.

blocks.source: イントロの雰囲気は気に入っています。それ以外は惰性と言われれば否定できない。
blocks.translation: I like the atmosphere of the intro. I can’t deny that the rest was made largely on autopilot.

blocks.source: NR_sea4.mp3（☆☆）
blocks.translation: NR_sea4.mp3 (☆☆)

blocks.source: 「海は広いな大きいな」のイメージで。苦労したわりに無難すぎる嫌いが……。１ループがやたら長い。
blocks.translation: It was based on the image of “The sea is wide and vast.” Despite all the effort it took, it may be too unassuming… The loop is ridiculously long.

blocks.source: NR_sea6.mp3（☆☆☆）
blocks.translation: NR_sea6.mp3 (☆☆☆)

blocks.source: 海底。
blocks.translation: The ocean floor.

blocks.source: 比較的短時間で作ったのですが、なかなか悪くありません。音源との相性が良かったのかな。
blocks.translation: I made it in a relatively short time, but it’s not bad at all. Maybe it was a good match for the sound source.

blocks.source: NR_sky2.mp3（☆☆☆）
blocks.translation: NR_sky2.mp3 (☆☆☆)

blocks.source: 飛行船。
blocks.translation: Airship.

blocks.source: 目指したのはＦＦ８です。何度も悩んで作り直したわりに、今一歩しっくり来ない。苦労はしたんですが……。
blocks.translation: I was aiming for FF8. Despite agonizing over it and reworking it many times, it still doesn’t quite feel right. I put a lot of work into it, though…
